OpenAI launches visual ads that appear alongside image generation results
8:14 AM PDT · October 5, 2026
ChatGPT is getting more ads. Specifically, OpenAI is adding visual display ads to its ad product line-up so that ads will appear alongside images that users ask
The new ads will begin to appear later this month in the U.S. only for now, and will feature products and services from an initial test group of advertisers. Th
The move follows the launch of Meta’s Muse, an agentic AI app which is free to everyone and a growing competitor for leading AI chatbots, like ChatGPT.
OpenAI introduced ads earlier this year to support its free and low-cost subscription tiers, and expanded them to India in August.
Now, the plan is to woo online advertisers who want to appeal to their potential customers by using more visual imagery to tell their stories. Eventually, those
However, integrating such ads could also prove disruptive to the user experience. But perhaps that’s partly the point, as the ads could push more casual users t
Alongside the display ads, OpenAI said it is expanding its measurement tools and partner ecosystem, which now includes click attribution solutions, AppsFlyer, T
OpenAI has also partnered with Haus, Measured, and WorkMagic to help advertisers explore “geo-based” experiments around ads.
The company said it’s working on developing brand suitability evaluation pilots with help from DoubleVerify (DV) and Integral Ad Science (IAS), which will help
Combined, the moves see OpenAI working to make ChatGPT a viable ad-supported business for those on free and low-cost plans.

OpenAI will start watermarking ChatGPT’s text in the EU
1:36 PM PDT · October 5, 2026
OpenAI will start adding an invisible watermark to text generated by ChatGPT and Codex in the European Union to comply with the EU AI Act, the company said Mond
The EU AI Act’s transparency rules, which took effect on August 2, require AI companies to mark AI-generated content in a way other systems can identify.
OpenAI said the watermark will roll out over the coming weeks to eligible ChatGPT and Codex users on all plans, but only in the EU. Developers using OpenAI’s AP
The watermark is not an actual symbol, but works by subtly shaping the model’s word choices, leaving a pattern readers can’t see, but a detector can pick up. Be
OpenAI also published a technical report for its method, called textGrain, alongside the announcement. Co-written with researchers from the University of Pennsy
Can the watermark be removed by editing? OpenAI’s tests suggest yes. In one test, replacing 10% of words with synonyms dropped detection from about 92% to 66%.

The announcement comes two months after Anthropic said it would watermark text generated by Claude, a move it’s applying worldwide. That decision drew backlash
OpenAI had built a text watermark before but held off on releasing it, partly over concerns that users would switch to rivals that didn’t watermark, The Wall St

Hot Girl Hotline is like ‘Dear Abby’ for the AI era

Now, two sisters are launching a startup for young women, Hot Girl Hotline, which focuses on bringing AI into these conversations.
I know what you may be thinking: With all the advances in AI technology, founders are building something for women to talk about their dating woes? Well … yes!
The reality is that people have already been turning to large language models (LLMs) via apps like ChatGPT for this type of advice, and the team believes this t
